title: Cadaverous
summary: CADAVEROUS, adjective 1. Having the appearance or color of a dead human body; pale; wan; ghastly; as a cadaverous look. 2. Having the qualities of a dead body.

inlines.v: CADAVEROUS, adjective 1. Having the appearance or color of a dead human body; pale; wan; ghastly; as a cadaverous look. 2. Having the qualities of a dead body.
